findings.current: Without the Myriad-Poison Ring, I would have estimated the chance at one in ten. Now, I believe it is over seventy percent.
findings.defect: The draft renders 일 푼 as one in ten, changing the original one-percent chance to ten percent.
findings.rationale: In traditional decimal units, one 푼 is one percent, while one 할 is ten percent. The source contrasts a one-percent chance without the ring against at least seventy percent with it.
findings.replacement: Without the Myriad-Poison Ring, the chance would have been just one percent. Now, I believe it is over seventy percent.
findings.source: 만독지환이 없었다면 일 푼의 가능성이었겠지만, 지금은 칠 할 이상으로 보고 있소.

findings.current: The Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake is not an ordinary venomous snake, but a spiritual creature. Yet you rendered the venom gland of such a creature useless… We will have to try it to know how much poison it can detoxify, but it is worthy of the name Myriad-Poison Ring.
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung the agent who neutralized the snake’s venom gland, but the Divine Physician is explaining what the Myriad-Poison Ring did.
findings.rationale: The surrounding discussion concerns the ring’s demonstrated efficacy, and the conclusion explicitly says that this feat makes it worthy of its name.
findings.replacement: The Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake is not an ordinary venomous snake, but a spiritual creature. Yet the ring rendered the venom gland of such a creature useless… We will have to try it to know how much poison it can detoxify, but it is worthy of the name Myriad-Poison Ring.
findings.source: 천년독각사는 평범한 독사가 아닌 영물(靈物). 한데 그런 것의 독샘을 무용지물로 만들었으니…… 어느 정도까지 해독할 수 있을지는 해 봐야 알겠지만, 역시 만독지환답구려.

findings.current: I bathe her in fragrant oil every morning and evening, so she smells wonderful. And her teeth are sparkling white!
findings.defect: The draft changes wiping Mimi’s body with scented oil into bathing her in oil.
findings.rationale: 몸을 닦아 주다 specifically describes wiping or rubbing down her body, not immersing or bathing her.
findings.replacement: I wipe her body down with fragrant oil every morning and evening, so she smells wonderful. And her teeth are sparkling white!
findings.source: 매일 아침저녁으로 향유(香油)로 몸을 닦아 줘서 향기롭고, 이빨도 새하얗고!

findings.current: As if a snake could understand him. What kind of technique was he trying to teach someone who could not even understand human speech?
findings.defect: The draft shifts the joke from Cheongpung ordering Mimi to perform a technique that even a person would not understand to the snake being unable to understand human speech, and changes an immediate command into an attempt to teach her.
findings.rationale: 사람도 못 알아듣는 modifies the technique or command as incomprehensible even to a person; 시키다 means making or telling Mimi to perform it.
findings.replacement: Whirlwind, my ass. He was telling her to perform a technique even a person wouldn’t understand.
findings.source: 회오리치기는 개뿔이. 사람도 못 알아듣는 기술을 시키다니.

findings.current: As Mungyeong looked calmly at his Master, who had deliberately furrowed his brow, he spoke.
findings.defect: The draft attaches calmness to Mungyeong’s gaze instead of preserving the explicit cue that he speaks in a calm voice.
findings.rationale: 침착한 목소리로 directly describes Mungyeong’s manner of speaking, while 짐짓 describes his Master’s affected or deliberate frown.
findings.replacement: Mungyeong addressed his Master, who had put on a frown, in a calm voice.
findings.source: 짐짓 얼굴을 찌푸린 스승을 향해 문경이 침착한 목소리로 말했다.

summary: One critical probability error, one major subject error in the ring’s mechanism, and three localized action or pragmatic-cue issues.
